prescribed_data: finitely generated abelian group H of rank 1, including its isomorphism type
integral Laurent polynomial in Z[H/Tors H]
iff_conditions: Delta(t)=t^k Delta(t^-1), with k an even integer
Delta(1)=plus or minus order of Tors H
not_the_claim: polynomial in full group ring Z[H]
primitive polynomial after discarding integral content
literal_ohtsuki.precision_limit: This page names the Alexander polynomial and its coefficient ring but does not itself define the elementary ideal or cover. The conventional integral free-abelian order is corroborated independently by the two named mathematical sources; it must not be claimed as an explicit definition printed in Conjecture 12.26.

independent_normalization.massuyeau: Definition 3.5, PDF/printed page 13: order over Z[G] of K/[K,K], G=H1/Tors H1, modulo units +/-G. Equation (3.2), page 14: the same order is H1 of the maximal free abelian cover.
independent_normalization.alcaraz: Section 2, pages 3-4: absolute integral homology of universal free abelian cover and 0th order over the integral free group ring; section 4.2 applies to closed orientable b1=1 manifolds.
independent_normalization.content: Z[t,t^-1] units are +/-t^j, so content cannot be divided out as a unit. Passing to Q[t,t^-1] loses this arithmetic information.
independent_normalization.surface_scope: Alcaraz 4.2 Theorem 4 provides a connected oriented nonseparating surface dual to the epimorphism to Z; Proposition 3 asserts free rank 2g of cut-open X, without asserting torsion-free integral homology or unimodularity of integral inclusions.
independent_normalization.polynomial_realization_scope: Alcaraz characterization chooses some closed orientable b1=1 manifold for a unit-symmetric nonzero-trace integral polynomial; its displayed statement does not prescribe a particular finite torsion group.

boundary_cases: cyclic torsion is known in the original remark
noncyclic torsion is not erased by replacing it with a cyclic group of equal order
Delta=0 is excluded by nonzero augmentation
rank other than 1 or manifolds with boundary are outside the stated target
